description: This file defines the SimpleFtpClient class, which implements FTP client operations such as connect, list files, set transfer mode, change mode, copy files, and close connection, using Apache Commons Net FTP library.

classes.name: SimpleFtpClient
classes.description: A class implementing FTP client functionalities such as connect, list files, set transfer mode, switch between passive and active modes, copy files, and disconnect, using Apache Commons Net FTP library.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes an FTP connection to the specified host with optional port and timeout, and performs login.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists files in the specified directory path.

methods.name: setBinaryTransfer
methods.description: Sets the transfer mode to binary or ASCII.

methods.name: setPassiveMode
methods.description: Switches between passive and active FTP modes.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Uploads a file to the specified directory.

methods.name: closeConnection
methods.description: Closes the FTP connection if open.
